descriptions.d10d_rgb5551_tile_801d814c: Convert the 4x4 block at (x, y) of an image of 16-bit 1-5-5-5 pixels stored in 32-bit slots (first halfword; bits 0-4, 5-9 and 10-14 widened by << 3 into r, g, b; bit 15 into alpha 255 or 0) into one big-endian RGB5A3 tile with 8-byte rows. Edge blocks are clipped (unsigned extents, at most 4); alpha above 223 gives an opaque texel (1, r5, g5, b5), otherwise a translucent one (0, a3, r4, g4, b4).
